title: Fandiablos
text: Ultimate Follower / Companion. Unique. A chaotic sacred flock of tiny breach-touched war-Chihuahuas joins the operative: scouting threats, swarming Grit battles, biting machine cabling, and sometimes causing Heat from pure battlefield enthusiasm.
flavor: They came through the breach barking. The enemy line broke before command understood why.
resolutionSummary: The Fandiablos flock answered the breach-whistle and joined the active operative as a unique ultimate companion.

effects.text: Fandiablos acquired: ultimate companion, unique, refreshes at the start of its owner's turn.
